bms_4168_0800308c.summary: Pulses the RCC reset line of a USART instance (USART1 to USART6); returns 1 for other pointers
bms_4168_0800308c.description: Resets one USART by writing a force-reset and then a release-reset to its bit in RCC APBRSTR2 (USART1 is bit 14, at 0x40021030) or RCC APBRSTR1 (USART2 bit 17, USART3 bit 18, USART4 bit 19, USART5 bit 8, USART6 bit 9, at 0x4002102C). It returns 0 (SUCCESS) for a known instance. For any other pointer it returns 1 and writes nothing.

bms_4168_0800325c.name: bms_rotate_word_bytes
bms_4168_0800325c.summary: Rotates the 4 bytes at param_1 by (param_2 & 3) positions, as in an AES RotWord step
bms_4168_0800325c.description: Copies the 4-byte word at param_1 into a stack temporary and writes it back rotated: result byte i is original byte (k + i) mod 4, where k = param_2 & 3. With k = 1 this is a one-byte rotation of the word, the same as the RotWord step in AES key expansion, so it may be a helper in a crypto routine. The initial value copied from param_4 is overwritten before use and has no effect.
